WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT CASE WHEN data->>'user_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (data->>'user_id')::uuid END user_id,CASE WHEN data->>'session_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (data->>'session_id')::uuid END session_id,CASE WHEN data->>'profile_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (data->>'profile_id')::uuid END profile_id FROM bind),
chosen AS (
 SELECT s.id,s.user_id,s.profile_id
 FROM input JOIN profile_ai_sessions s ON s.user_id=input.user_id JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id JOIN profiles p ON p.id=s.profile_id
 WHERE input.user_id IS NOT NULL AND input.session_id IS NOT NULL AND input.profile_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id=input.session_id AND s.profile_id=input.profile_id AND lower(u.role)='woman' AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND p.status='DRAFT'
 LIMIT 1
)
SELECT chosen.id IS NOT NULL session_available,chosen.id::text session_id,chosen.user_id::text,chosen.profile_id::text,CASE WHEN chosen.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
  'profile',(SELECT to_jsonb(p)-'user_id'-'created_at'-'updated_at' FROM profiles p WHERE p.id=chosen.profile_id),
  'prices',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.position,x.id) FROM profile_prices x WHERE x.profile_id=chosen.profile_id AND x.is_active),'[]'::jsonb),
  'meeting_places',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.position,x.id) FROM profile_meeting_places x WHERE x.profile_id=chosen.profile_id AND x.is_active),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) END existing_state,CASE WHEN chosen.id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END ok,CASE WHEN chosen.id IS NULL THEN 'WOMAN_SESSION_NOT_AVAILABLE' END code,CASE WHEN chosen.id IS NULL THEN 'Сессия анкеты недоступна. Нажмите /start.' END message
FROM input LEFT JOIN chosen ON true;

WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT (data->>'profile_id')::uuid profile_id,data->>'photo_file_id' telegram_file_id FROM bind),
profile_guard AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(input.profile_id::text)) FROM input)
INSERT INTO profile_photos(profile_id,telegram_file_id,position)
SELECT input.profile_id,input.telegram_file_id,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(p.position) FROM profile_photos p WHERE p.profile_id=input.profile_id),-1)+1
FROM input CROSS JOIN profile_guard
ON CONFLICT(profile_id,telegram_file_id) WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL AND telegram_file_id IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE SET telegram_file_id=EXCLUDED.telegram_file_id
RETURNING id::text,position;

parameters.body: ={{JSON.stringify({model:$env.DEEPSEEK_MODEL||'deepseek-chat',response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:'Extract only explicitly stated WOMAN profile data. Allowed scalar keys: name, age, city, district, height_cm, weight_kg, breast_size, description. Never infer. Existing prices and meeting places are supplied with IDs. Return strict JSON {fields:{},price_operations:[],meeting_place_operations:[],clarification:null}. Each collection operation is APPEND with full fields, UPDATE with existing id and full fields, or DELETE with existing id. Never replace a collection implicitly. Ambiguous breast size must produce clarification.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({message:$('Normalize WOMAN Input').item.json.text,existing_state:$('Load WOMAN Draft Session').item.json.existing_state})}]})}}

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content??$json; const out=typeof raw==='string'?JSON.parse(raw):raw; const allowed=new Set(['name','age','city','district','height_cm','weight_kg','breast_size','description']); const fields={}; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(out.fields||{})){if(allowed.has(k)&&v!==null&&v!=='')fields[k]=v;} if(fields.age!==undefined&&(Number(fields.age)<18||Number(fields.age)>100))throw new Error('Invalid age'); if(fields.height_cm!==undefined&&(Number(fields.height_cm)<100||Number(fields.height_cm)>250))throw new Error('Invalid height'); if(fields.weight_kg!==undefined&&(Number(fields.weight_kg)<30||Number(fields.weight_kg)>300))throw new Error('Invalid weight'); if(fields.breast_size!==undefined&&(Number(fields.breast_size)<0||Number(fields.breast_size)>20))throw new Error('Invalid breast size'); const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i; const op=(x)=>String(x.operation||'APPEND').toUpperCase(); const rawPrices=Array.isArray(out.price_operations)?out.price_operations:(Array.isArray(out.prices)?out.prices.map(x=>({...x,operation:'APPEND'})):[]); const price_operations=rawPrices.map(p=>{const operation=op(p),id=p.id==null?null:String(p.id);if(!['APPEND','UPDATE','DELETE'].includes(operation))throw new Error('Invalid price operation');if(operation!=='APPEND'&&!uuid.test(id||''))throw new Error('Price id required');if(operation==='DELETE')return{operation,id};const amount=Number(p.amount),service_name=String(p.service_name||'').trim(),currency=String(p.currency||'RUB').toUpperCase();if(!service_name||!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<0||!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(currency))throw new Error('Invalid price');return{operation,id,service_name,amount,currency,duration_minutes:p.duration_minutes==null?null:Number(p.duration_minutes),description:p.description==null?null:String(p.description)};}); const placeTypes=new Set(['HER_PLACE','HIS_PLACE','HOTEL','PUBLIC_PLACE','OTHER']); const rawPlaces=Array.isArray(out.meeting_place_operations)?out.meeting_place_operations:(Array.isArray(out.meeting_places)?out.meeting_places.map(x=>({...x,operation:'APPEND'})):[]); const meeting_place_operations=rawPlaces.map(p=>{const operation=op(p),id=p.id==null?null:String(p.id);if(!['APPEND','UPDATE','DELETE'].includes(operation))throw new Error('Invalid place operation');if(operation!=='APPEND'&&!uuid.test(id||''))throw new Error('Place id required');if(operation==='DELETE')return{operation,id};const place_type=String(p.place_type||'').toUpperCase(),label=String(p.label||'').trim();if(!placeTypes.has(place_type)||!label)throw new Error('Invalid meeting place');return{operation,id,place_type,label,district:p.district==null?null:String(p.district),description:p.description==null?null:String(p.description)};}); return [{json:{payload_json:JSON.stringify({fields,price_operations,meeting_place_operations,clarification:out.clarification||null}),session_id:$('Load WOMAN Draft Session').item.json.session_id,profile_id:$('Load WOMAN Draft Session').item.json.profile_id}}];

parameters.query:
WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT (data->>'session_id')::uuid session_id FROM bind)
SELECT p.id::text profile_id,s.id::text session_id,p.name,p.age,p.city,p.city_normalized,p.district,p.height_cm,p.weight_kg,p.breast_size,p.description,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_photos x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id) photo_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_prices x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id AND x.is_active) price_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM profile_meeting_places x WHERE x.profile_id=p.id AND x.is_active) meeting_place_count
FROM input JOIN profile_ai_sessions s ON s.id=input.session_id JOIN profiles p ON p.id=s.profile_id
WHERE s.id=input.session_id AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS';

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; const checks=[['name',x.name],['age',x.age],['city',x.city_normalized],['district',x.district],['height',x.height_cm],['weight',x.weight_kg],['breast_size',x.breast_size],['description',x.description],['photos',Number(x.photo_count)>0],['prices',Number(x.price_count)>0],['meeting_places',Number(x.meeting_place_count)>0]]; const i=checks.findIndex(([,v])=>v===null||v===undefined||v===''||v===false); const questions={name:'Как тебя зовут?',age:'Сколько тебе лет?',city:'В каком городе ты живёшь?',district:'Какой район?',height:'Какой у тебя рост в сантиметрах?',weight:'Какой вес в килограммах?',breast_size:'Укажи числовой размер груди.',description:'Расскажи о себе.',photos:'Добавь хотя бы одно фото.',prices:'Укажи цены.',meeting_places:'Укажи места встречи.'}; return [{json:{...x,complete:i<0,current_step:i<0?checks.length:i,next_block:i<0?null:checks[i][0],question:i<0?null:questions[checks[i][0]]}}];

parameters.query:
WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT (data->>'session_id')::uuid session_id FROM bind),
eligible AS (SELECT s.id session_id,s.user_id,s.profile_id FROM input JOIN profile_ai_sessions s ON s.id=input.session_id JOIN profiles p ON p.id=s.profile_id WHERE s.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND p.status='DRAFT' FOR UPDATE OF s,p),
profile AS (UPDATE profiles p SET status='PENDING_MODERATION',updated_at=now() FROM eligible e WHERE p.id=e.profile_id AND p.status='DRAFT' RETURNING p.id),
completed AS (UPDATE profile_ai_sessions s SET status='COMPLETED',updated_at=now() FROM eligible e,profile p WHERE s.id=e.session_id AND s.profile_id=p.id AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS' RETURNING s.user_id,s.profile_id),
moderation AS (INSERT INTO profile_moderation(profile_id,moderator_type,status) SELECT c.profile_id,'AI','PENDING' FROM completed c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profile_moderation m WHERE m.profile_id=c.profile_id AND m.status='PENDING') RETURNING id),
audit AS (INSERT INTO audit_events(user_id,event_type,event_data) SELECT c.user_id,'profile_created',jsonb_build_object('profile_id',c.profile_id) FROM completed c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_events a WHERE a.event_type='profile_created' AND a.event_data->>'profile_id'=c.profile_id::text) RETURNING id)
SELECT completed.profile_id IS NOT NULL ok,completed.profile_id::text,CASE WHEN completed.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Спасибо! Анкета отправлена на модерацию.' ELSE 'Состояние анкеты изменилось. Нажмите /start.' END message,CASE WHEN completed.profile_id IS NULL THEN 'WOMAN_FINALIZATION_NOT_AVAILABLE' END code FROM input LEFT JOIN completed ON true;
